conditions: The INCLUDE line is processed under the working document’s source-text inclusion rules.
limitations: The statement describes the dated J3/24-007 working text. Compiler behavior and final ISO conformance have separate scopes.

triggers: A different exact source, a WG5 or J3 correction, changed document scope, or a conflicting governing source.

statement: J3/24-007 describes an INCLUDE line as if the referenced source text replaced that line before program processing. Additional INCLUDE lines can nest, with the maximum nesting depth processor dependent.
